mechanism_narrative: Low federal funds rate indicates easy monetary policy, boosting equity valuations and leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not higher when FEDFUNDS is low (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts signal economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: Returns are negative when housing starts rise (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Declining unemployment and rising employment indicate a strong labor market, boosting S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: Returns are not higher with improving labor metrics (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth in an expansion signals positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: Returns are negative when industrial production grows (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Rising inflation leads to tighter monetary policy, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: Returns are positive when inflation rises (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Higher real consumer spending boosts economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: Returns are not higher with increased spending (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Low unemployment signals a strong economy, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: Returns are negative when unemployment is low (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Strong GDP growth and low unemployment indicate a robust economy, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: Returns are not higher with strong GDP and low unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).
